breakingChanges: svelte.config.js is no longer read (build fails with config_file_unsupported); options move to the sveltekit() plugin in vite.config.js, with former config.kit.* options at the top level
$app/stores is removed (build fails with app_stores_removed); use $app/state and read page.url.pathname without the $ prefix
Minimums: Node >=22.17, TypeScript ^6, Svelte ^5.57.1, Vite ^8.0.12, @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte ^7 (kit 3.0.0 peerDependencies and engines on npm)
